rule_verbatim: A claim is UNAFFECTED iff (b)/(d) SOURCE shows the changed code is not on its forced path, or the probe in (c) shows identical overlay map state in every arm of that claim between the old line and 9a2b1d99e. Otherwise it is AFFECTED.

forced_path.timing_claims: every Driver code path executed between the claim's T0 and its oracle read in any arm, including awaits on the agent-cursor arrival and the focus-guard post-check
forced_path.count_claims: the decision code that produces the counted outcome (refusal, landing, restore, reconnect, duplicate) plus every window-system read that this decision consumes

overlay_rs_on_forced_path_iff_any.T1: an arm has the agent cursor enabled for an action inside T on X11, so the action awaits (or races) an X11 overlay paint whose code changed (map/unmap transitions in paint_x11_tiles / blank_x11_overlay_shape)
overlay_rs_on_forced_path_iff_any.T2: the claim's counted decision, or a step inside T, reads the X11 map state of override-redirect root children without excluding the agent overlay (SOURCE: platform-linux input/focus_guard.rs mapped_popups(), which has no own-overlay filter; input/foreground.rs window set, which keeps pid-less popups). tools/impl_.rs:976 filters titles starting with 'Cua.' and does not count.
overlay_rs_on_forced_path_iff_any.T3: the claim is a timing claim whose arms all have the cursor off, and the probe does NOT show the old line's startup MapWindow of the overlay completed before the MCP initialize reply in 5/5 runs of every old binary (T0 is always after initialize in every harness)

rule_operationalization.count_claim_exception: For a count claim, T1 alone does not make it AFFECTED: a shifted arrival time is not the counted quantity. T2 makes a count claim AFFECTED only when the read feeds the counted decision (a focus-guard restore / report that is counted). A count decided before the guard post-check (refusal before delivery, landing seen by a target-owned oracle) is UNAFFECTED by SOURCE.
rule_operationalization.expectation_rs_on_forced_path_iff: the claim calls Driver verify_state (expectation::VerifyStateTool, the only caller of evaluate_predicates) OR any Linux producer (platform-linux, cua-driver-core, jev-use) can emit an element field display_only=true on 9a2b1d99e. If neither, the partition returns the unchanged match list and project_element adds no key: UNAFFECTED.
rule_operationalization.version_bump_on_forced_path_iff: any CUA_DRIVER_* env read or tool-schema code differs between the two sources apart from version strings (SOURCE diff of the Linux crates: cua-driver, cua-driver-core, cua-driver-sdk, cua-driver-contract, platform-linux, cursor-overlay)
rule_operationalization.unaffected_never_from_absence: An UNAFFECTED call cites SOURCE (file:line on 9a2b1d99e) and, for overlay.rs, the probe facts. Not observing an effect is never sufficient.

probe_1c.class: FIXTURE fact (window tree), not timing; SHARED quiet-lane lock not required; run under bin/hostless + cua-x11-session.sh with CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1

binaries.M: plain 9a2b1d99e cua-driver-fresh07-main-9a2b1d99e sha256 795dca5abd96e9a28cc8b59fc9cb3059c28f1b9e4d0ac1d2ebe8a7360c402f6f (0.33.0), built with build-driver.sh fresh07-main cua-release-fresh07 under the cargo lock and hostless

probe_1c.n: 5 runs per binary; each run = fresh GTK3 task fixture (repository libs/cua-driver/tests/fixtures/apps/linux/gtk3/main.py) + fresh Driver (mcp over stdio), no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* variable, telemetry off
states_per_run: S0 spawn: a 2 ms X-tree poller records every overlay state transition from Driver spawn (first appearance, first VIEWABLE / UNMAPPED) and the time of the MCP initialize reply
S1 idle: after initialize + list_windows + set_agent_cursor_motion {} and 300 ms quiet

S2 feedback-on action: get_window_state, then background click on the 'I agree' check box by element_token (the N-03/N-04/OWN-20 forced route), product-default cursor; tree read immediately after the reply (oracle-read time) and again after 1.5 s
S3 feedback-off action: set_agent_cursor_enabled {enabled:false}; tree read; then the same background click; tree read immediately after the reply and after 1.5 s
probe_1c.per_read_fields: overlay window(s) titled Cua.AgentCursorOverlay.* with map_state, override_redirect, bounding and input shape rectangle counts; XGetInputFocus; _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW; top of _NET_CLIENT_LIST_STACKING; the set of mapped override-redirect root children (the focus guard's popup view); XQueryPointer child of root
probe_1c.per_action_fields: the click's structured focus-guard fields (focus_changed, focus_restored, focus_outcome, grab_held_by) and its text content; the fixture state file before/after (target-owned oracle: agreed toggles, seq increments)
probe_1c.oracle: the private X server's window tree read by an independent ctypes libX11/libXext client in the harness process (never the Driver)

expectations_written_before_running.E1: old binaries: overlay VIEWABLE with 0 bounding and 0 input rectangles at S1; M: overlay exists and is UNMAPPED at S1
expectations_written_before_running.E2: S2 immediately after the reply: overlay VIEWABLE with non-empty bounding shape on every binary
expectations_written_before_running.E3: S3 after set_agent_cursor_enabled false: old VIEWABLE (empty shape), M UNMAPPED; after the native click the cursor may be revived by reveal_pointer_action_for (recorded, not assumed)
expectations_written_before_running.E4: focus, active window and stacking top identical between old and new at every state (the overlay is override-redirect with an empty input shape)
expectations_written_before_running.E5: M may report grab_held_by on the background click (focus_guard mapped_popups sees the newly mapped overlay); old binaries never do. Counted descriptively k/5 per binary.
expectations_written_before_running.P_start: old binaries: overlay VIEWABLE before the initialize reply in 5/5 (decides T3)

probe_1c.decision_use: Identical overlay map state in every arm of a claim (probe clause) is judged from S1/S2/S3 per binary family; T3 from P_start; E5 is a concrete check of T2.
